summary.text: Kyandra Darling is the Democratic nominee for Florida House of Representatives District 62; she defeated Wengay Newton in the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary, and the general election was canceled.
Ballotpedia lists her as member-elect, with an assumed office date of November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kyandra Darling was born in St. Petersburg, Florida, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit worker.
She previously worked as a legislative aide for city council members in St. Petersburg.
